evidence.title: This Coach Is Banned From Working With Kids. Why Is He Still Coaching?

occurrences.checkable_against: Protecting Young Victims from Sexual Abuse and SafeSport enforcement requirements
occurrences.quote_span: Once Richardson was suspended by SafeSport, the law required USA Volleyball to ensure he was not working with its athletes.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: Texas Fierce Elite practice records and public social-media videos
occurrences.quote_span: But Richardson is still coaching teenage girls at his gym in Pharr.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Center for SafeSport disciplinary decision
occurrences.quote_span: On Feb. 19, the Center for SafeSport ruled that Richardson was banned from coaching.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Center for SafeSport
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: Lone Star complaint emails and attached evidence
occurrences.quote_span: But by then, Lone Star had received reports from three people alleging that Richardson was violating his suspension, ProPublica and The Post found.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: USA Volleyball internal review and compliance records
occurrences.quote_span: A spokesperson for USA Volleyball said in a statement that the organization had done an “internal review” of the incidents in ProPublica and The Post’s story and “confirmed that USA Volleyball has fully complied with all SafeSport requirements, U.S. Center for SafeSport regulations, and our own organizational policies and procedures.”
occurrences.speaker: USA Volleyball spokesperson
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Center for SafeSport temporary suspension notice
occurrences.quote_span: He was temporarily suspended from coaching under USA Volleyball and all other sports organizations covered by SafeSport’s mandate while the investigation ran its course.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Center for SafeSport
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: Lone Star Region membership and good-standing records
occurrences.quote_span: With a new season set to begin in September 2025, Lone Star allowed Texas Fierce Elite to remain in good standing. And it approved Rudder, who was listed as the club’s director, for another year of membership.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: Adidas Bluegrass Tournament registration and video records
occurrences.quote_span: Shortly after being placed on the SafeSport list, on March 8, Richardson was at the Adidas Bluegrass Tournament in Louisville, coaching the Texas Fierce Elite team that another coach had said “no one else touched.” Richardson was registered as the coach.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: USA Volleyball and Lone Star emails, reports and membership records
occurrences.quote_span: both USA Volleyball and Lone Star had received multiple reports that Richardson was still coaching, but Lone Star allowed his club to remain a regional member, and USA Volleyball did not object.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: Ryan Richardson Instagram post and Texas Fierce Elite training records
occurrences.quote_span: On Feb. 13, 2026, Richardson posted a video of himself training Texas Fierce Elite’s under-14 team.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: USA Volleyball-sanctioned tournament registration records
occurrences.quote_span: By January, Rudder and Texas Fierce Elite were back at USA Volleyball-sanctioned tournaments.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: SafeSport, USA Volleyball and Lone Star membership, disciplinary and incident records
occurrences.quote_span: SafeSport, USA Volleyball and its regional partner Lone Star all failed to keep Richardson from interacting with children, ProPublica and The Post found, even as allegations of inappropriate behavior and abuse piled up.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Center for SafeSport disciplinary database
occurrences.quote_span: In February 2025, one year after Richardson’s social media posts were sent to SafeSport, Richardson’s name appeared in the center’s disciplinary database.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Center for SafeSport case timeline and disciplinary records
occurrences.quote_span: SafeSport delayed suspending Richardson for months despite the serious allegations, ProPublica and The Post found.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: Ryan Richardson's public Instagram archive
occurrences.quote_span: Nearly every day for the last two years, Richardson has posted videos in which he works with Texas Fierce Elite players, supervises practices and promotes the club — hundreds of posts in all, often visible to the public.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: McAllen and Pharr criminal court and police records
occurrences.quote_span: Richardson, who has not been charged with any crime, did not respond to multiple requests for comment for this story.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: Junior Volleyball Association membership records
occurrences.quote_span: In July 2025, four months after Richardson was suspended by SafeSport, JVA renewed his membership.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. Center for SafeSport disciplinary database and decision
occurrences.quote_span: In February of this year, SafeSport listed Richardson as “permanently ineligible” to coach, saying it had substantiated a litany of allegations against him: that he had had an intimate relationship with a minor, committed sexual misconduct involving a minor, and engaged in physical misconduct and bullying.
occurrences.speaker: U.S. Center for SafeSport
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: Texas Fierce Elite practice records and Richardson's Instagram posts
occurrences.quote_span: On Feb. 20, Richardson was back to training Texas Fierce Elite players, and he was back to posting.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson

occurrences.checkable_against: SafeSport case-opening records and Longoria's email
occurrences.quote_span: In January 2025 she emailed Krasley, the SafeSport investigator. It had been eight months since SafeSport’s investigation began.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Ryan Richardson
